issues_found.description: VLD-02 AC1 (guard compiles to non-bool -> TypeMismatch) is not asserted at the integration layer. Post-R7 int_vld_02_01 covers the 12 positive operator cases (0 findings) and the OperandTypeError negative (s > 0), but no integration test drives a non-bool gateway guard and asserts TypeMismatch. The behavior IS pinned by the in-file unit test 'checkSite: number literal where bool expected -> TypeMismatch' (src/validation/typecheck.zig:425, part of test-validation 40/40). Spec §1/§4/§5.3 text still describes int_vld_02_01 as 'returns TypeMismatch on guard that compiles to non-bool' — stale vs the R7-reworked block. Recommend either (a) adding a TypeMismatch integration assertion (e.g. gateway guard 'a + b' -> TypeMismatch naming bool expected / number actual) or (b) aligning the spec text with the R7 state.
